title: Bible Verse Sudoku
subtitle: 120 Easy Puzzles with Scripture from the King James Version

title: Bible Verse Sudoku: Psalms
subtitle: 120 Easy Puzzles with Psalms from the King James Version
paragraphs: Bible Verse Sudoku: Psalms pairs 120 Easy Sudoku puzzles with 120 verses from the Book of Psalms in the King James Version. Each puzzle sits on its own page with room to work, and each verse is printed exactly, with chapter and verse.

The twelve chapters follow the journey of the Psalms from praise to trust. They begin with the heavens, a joyful noise, and mercy that endures; they make room for honest prayer; they walk the blessed way of wisdom and stand before a righteous King; and they come to rest in trust, with the Lord as shepherd, refuge, and keeper of a quiet heart. Every chapter opens with a pencil illustration, and every verse has an illustration of its own.
Every puzzle has exactly one solution. Complete solutions are in the back, six to a page.
For adults 50+ who enjoy an approachable puzzle and a few unhurried minutes with the Psalms.
